explanation: The Methods page states what the code does: BH families are per fitted comparison for genes and per collection for pathways; rounding follows fmtP; gene sets map to the target recorded in FGSEA provenance; a missing pathway may have been dropped or, in a release-built copy, be KEGG; report denominators are the studies that measured the gene; cutoffs and the star table come from policy.ts and format.ts; the dataset count comes from the registry. The gene-count range is no longer hard-coded.
